prompt: In a photorealistic photo, a rugged mountain campsite unfolds under a clear sky. On the left, a man in a red scarf sits on a log, his posture relaxed. Next to him stands a woman in a blue jacket, holding a metal mug. A brown dog lies at their feet, eyes closed. In the center, a large orange tent dominates the view, its flap open. A child in a yellow hat peeks out from the tent entrance. Beside the tent, a silver kettle rests on a portable stove. A man in a green vest stirs the contents of the kettle with a wooden spoon. To the right of the stove, a stack of firewood is neatly arranged. A black bear cub watches from the tree line, partially hidden by shadows. Above the bear, an eagle soars through the air, wings spread wide. Near the firewood, a woman in a purple beanie points toward the distant peaks. A man in a gray hoodie looks in the direction she indicates. A white cat sits atop a cooler next to the woman in the purple beanie. The cooler is positioned near a picnic table. On the picnic table, a map lies flat, weighed down by a rock. A boy in an orange shirt traces a route on the map with his finger. A girl in a pink dress stands beside the boy, looking at the map. A lantern hangs from a branch above the picnic table, unlit. A backpack leans against the trunk of a pine tree nearby. There is no snow on the ground. There is no vehicle visible in the scene. There is no smoke rising from the stove.
